description: A false-colour satellite image illustrating the "Airports" land cover category, identified by CORINE Land Cover (CLC) code 1240. The image displays an airport with a prominent, long, sealed runway, multiple taxiways, and associated buildings. Surrounding the airport infrastructure are areas classified as associated land, likely grassland or bare soil, which appear in muted green tones. Several clusters of urban or settlement buildings are visible, particularly to the north and east of the airport. The wider landscape consists of agricultural fields, depicted in various shades of red and green, indicating different vegetation types or crop stages in this false-colour composite. A winding river, appearing dark blue, traverses the lower portion of the image, bordered by linear features which might be roads or irrigation canals. The image highlights the distinctive appearance of airport facilities within a mixed agricultural and semi-urban environment.
